mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDPC1 indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings are likely to improve.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 4% signals a strong labor market, which may lead to inflationary pressures and potential rate hikes, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 4% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE is high, it indicates tightening monetary policy, which can slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increases with high UNRATE but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in INDPRO growth during a late-cycle expansion signals potential economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth slows but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing PAYEMS indicates a strong labor market, which may boost consumer spending and lead to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPIAUCSL above 2% may lead to inflation concerns, prompting tighter monetary policy and negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 2% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: If GDPC1 growth slows while CPIAUCSL rises, it may indicate stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth decelerates and CPIAUCSL increases
failure_condition: GDPC1 slows with rising CPIAUCSL but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in HOUST indicates weakening housing market, which may signal broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: HOUST declines but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.
